prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: actual game character UV texture atlas, not concept art.
Input image 1 is the edit target: sixteen square texture cells arranged in an exact 4 by 4 grid. Each cell fills precisely one quarter of the image width and height. No gutters, no grid lines, no captions. Keep EVERY cell in exactly its original position; preserve original UV feature positions, boundaries between skin and cloth, and shading direction. Output a sharp high-resolution square atlas.

Primary request: transform Anna Williams's red evening dress costume into a Jessica Rabbit inspired costume from Who Framed Roger Rabbit. Visual reference is the original 1988 Disney production color-model cel: copper orange-red hair, crimson strapless gown, lavender purple long opera gloves, violet eye shadow, red lips and green eyes. Refine this into high quality painted game textures with fine red sequins on the gown, smooth lavender satin gloves and lustrous copper hair. It must stay usable on the existing original mesh.

Exact cell instructions, reading rows top to bottom, columns left to right:
Row 1 col 1: closed-eye face. Preserve the exact face anatomy, location, skin tone and closed eyelids. Refine with soft lavender eye shadow, defined lashes and red lips. No hair painted onto face.
Row 1 col 2: red skirt panel. Remove all yellow borders, flowers and embroidery; replace with continuous rich crimson red fine sequined fabric, softly shaded original folds.
Row 1 col 3: red skirt panel. Remove the entire colorful bird motif; replace with the same continuous crimson fine sequined fabric. No bird, no yellow trim, no remaining emblem.
Row 1 col 4: red WAIST fabric, stays the identical crimson sequin gown material, not gloves.

Row 2 col 1: upper torso with bare upper chest and sweetheart red bodice. Preserve the exact existing diagonal skin/cloth boundary and skin complexion; only red cloth becomes crimson sequins. No exposed new areas, no change of neckline shape.
Row 2 col 2: open-eye face. Preserve feature coordinates and complexion; HD refinement, green iris, lavender shadow, long lashes, red lips. No added hair on face.
Row 2 col 3: BARE UPPER ARM skin. Preserve the skin color and existing light-to-shadow gradient, smoothly refined. No glove painted here.
Row 2 col 4: long FOREARM GLOVE fabric. Replace all red with medium-light lavender purple satin, softly reflective, matching Jessica's opera gloves, with original folds.

Row 3 col 1: upper BACK and chest skin above red bodice. Preserve the exact skin/cloth boundary; skin remains the original peach, red cloth becomes the same fine crimson sequins.
Row 3 col 2: NECK/CHOKER. Remove the red lower band, replace with peach skin matching the upper area; smooth shaded skin across this whole cell. No fabric on the neck.
Row 3 col 3: GLOVE FINGERS. Replace all red with matching lavender purple satin, preserving all vertical dark finger separators in dark purple.
Row 3 col 4: FOOT WITH RED HIGH HEEL. Preserve the precise diagonal shoe edge. Keep the shoe polished crimson red; change only the brown stocking/ankle region to softly shaded fair peach skin, matching her bare arm skin.

Row 4 col 1: entire brown STOCKING/LEG. Replace brown hosiery with fair peach bare-leg skin matching the face and upper arms; preserve the soft original cylindrical lighting, no seams, jewelry, gloves or new features.
Row 4 col 2: brown HAIR sheet. Change to flowing shiny copper orange-red locks with fine individual strands, original vertical fall, original dark root placement. Do not draw a face or complete head here.
Row 4 col 3: brown HAIR fringe sheet. Matching glossy copper orange-red hair strands, subtly swept, matching row4col2 hair.
Row 4 col 4: red elbow GLOVE BOW/cuff folds. Replace all red with lavender purple satin matching both glove cells.

Overall: game-ready texture artwork aligned exactly to the reference atlas. Fine subtle material detail, no exaggerated sparkles or white glitter blobs. Unified gown red across all cloth cells and unified glove purple. Preserve same lighting and form cues without pixelated edges. No character render, no text, no mockup, no background, no rearrangement or merging of cells.
source: Locally extracted Anna BNS 217 red gown, first sixteen textures in a 4 by 4 atlas
